subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Do maintainers accept the new immutable commits for actions that receive secrets, mint write-capable tokens, publish images, run Codex, or upload security results?
rationale: The patch is mechanically narrow, but accepting new third-party executable code at privileged workflow boundaries is a repository trust decision that tests cannot resolve.

options.title: Approve the grouped refresh
options.body: Review the upstream changes and accept all proposed immutable pins once required checks settle on this exact head.

options.title: Split privileged actions
options.body: Separate Codex, token-minting, Docker publishing, and CodeQL changes from routine setup-action updates for narrower trust review.

options.title: Hold existing pins
options.body: Keep the current pins until the privileged action changes can be reviewed or upgraded individually.

recommendation.title: Approve the grouped refresh
recommendation.body: Review the upstream changes and accept all proposed immutable pins once required checks settle on this exact head.
